name: Dynamic 3D Gaussians
aliases: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis
definition: A method that performs tracking by persistent dynamic view synthesis, linking the motion of each Gaussian to the movement of a corresponding 3D point in the scene.
summary: Dynamic 3D Gaussians is a Lagrangian particle-based method for dynamic scene novel-view synthesis and 6-DOF tracking that fixes geometric attributes after initialization and optimizes only motion parameters with physical regularization.
